name: Smith.ai
summary: An AI receptionist answers, qualifies and books your calls 24/7, with the option of live human receptionists behind it.
pricing: Free: 25 calls/mo ($3/call after). Pro from $150/mo for 75 calls. Enterprise from $500/mo.
cons: Per-call pricing adds up on busy lines

name: Ruby
summary: Trained human virtual receptionists (with AI assist) answer your calls live, so every caller hears a real person.
pricing: From $250/mo for 50 minutes.

name: Dialzara
summary: AI receptionist that answers calls, takes messages, transfers urgent calls and books appointments.
pricing: From $29/mo (60 minutes); higher tiers from $99/mo. 7-day free trial.
cons: Low minute cap on entry plan

name: My AI Front Desk
summary: AI receptionist bundled with web chat, two-way texting and a simple CRM.
pricing: Business-in-a-Box $99/mo ($79/mo billed annually) incl. 200 voice minutes; overage about $0.25/min.

name: Rosie
summary: Low-cost AI answering service for home-service and local businesses that captures leads and texts you summaries.
pricing: From $49/mo for 250 minutes; next tier $149/mo for 1,000 minutes.
cons: Jumps to next plan rather than overage

name: Goodcall
summary: AI phone agent with unlimited minutes, priced by how many unique callers you get.
pricing: Starter $79/mo per agent ($66 billed annually): unlimited minutes, 100 unique callers, then $0.50 per extra caller.
cons: Costs rise with many new callers

name: Upfirst
summary: Simple AI answering service for small businesses that answers, screens and takes messages.
pricing: Starter $24.95/mo for 30 calls ($1.50 per extra call); Premium $59.95 (90 calls); Pro $159.95 (300 calls). 20% off annually; 14-day trial.

name: NextPhone
summary: AI receptionist with unlimited calls aimed at service businesses that never want to miss a job.
pricing: From $199/mo with unlimited calls (third-party report, Sep 2026).

name: Quo (formerly OpenPhone)
summary: Business phone system with an AI agent that answers when your team can't.
pricing: From $15/user/mo billed annually, with limited AI call credits (third-party report, Sep 2026).

name: Abby Connect
summary: Human receptionist team with AI tools, assigned to your business for a personal feel.
pricing: From $165/mo for 50 minutes (third-party report, Sep 2026).
